integration.screen_clips: Use world/actor base yaw zero. Existing renderer fixed left/right yaw must be bypassed when selecting these absolute screen clips. This task does not edit the renderer.
integration.relative_turn_clips: TurnStep is local heading delta. Start from canonical forward locomotion, rebase delta once when done.
integration.source_timeline: Blender frame 1 starts each action; new GLB inputs normalized to t=0 without modifying the old animation inputs.
integration.mesh_count_policy: Reuse every existing mesh/rig; no facing-specific meshes created.
